info.title: OpenDMSBackend v3.1.0 API documentation
info.description: OpenDMSBackend is the backend of OpenDMS.

get.summary: Returns the list of configured OIDC providers. An empty list means OIDC login is not available.
Initiates an OIDC login for the specified provider. Returns the authorization URL to redirect the user to.

parameters.name: providerId
parameters.description: The id of the OIDC provider (e.g. "keycloak-1").

post.summary:
Exchanges the OIDC authorization code for an OpenDMS access token.
Creates a new OpenDMS account for the user on their first login via this provider.
Uploads a new document into the specified container.

parameters.name: containerId
parameters.description: The ID of the container (folder or storage location) to add the document to.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The file name for the uploaded document.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: An optional display title for the document.

parameters.name: additionalOCRLanguages
parameters.description: Additional languages to use during OCR processing.

requestBody.description: The raw binary content of the document.

put.summary: Updates the display title of an existing document.

parameters.name: documentId
parameters.description: The ID of the document whose title should be updated.

requestBody.description: The new title value to assign to the document.

post.summary: Creates a new folder inside the specified parent folder.

parameters.name: parentFolderId
parameters.description: The ID of the parent folder in which to create the new folder.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the new folder.

post.summary: Renames the specified container to the given new name.

parameters.name: containerId
parameters.description: The id of the container to rename.

post.summary: Moves the specified containee into the target container.

parameters.name: containeeIdToMove
parameters.description: The id of the document or folder to move.

parameters.name: targetContainerId
parameters.description: The id of the container to move the item into.

post.summary: Grants the specified user permission to view the specified storage location.

parameters.name: storageLocationId
parameters.description: The id of the storage location to share.

parameters.name: sharedWithUserId
parameters.description: The id of the user to grant access to.

post.summary: Revokes the specified user's permission to view the specified storage location.

parameters.name: storageLocationId
parameters.description: The id of the storage location.

parameters.name: sharedWithUserId
parameters.description: The id of the user whose access should be revoked.

post.summary: Creates a new storage location with the given name owned by the current user.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The display name of the new storage location.

get.summary: Returns the storage location with the specified id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the storage location to retrieve.

get.summary: Returns all storage locations the current user is allowed to view.
Returns the folder with the specified id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the folder to retrieve.

get.summary: Searches for documents visible to the current user that match the given search term.

parameters.name: searchTerm
parameters.description: The term to search for across document titles, filenames, tags, and OCR content.

get.summary: Returns the full document with the specified id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the document to retrieve.

get.summary: Returns the full document identified by its human-readable numeric id.

parameters.name: readableId
parameters.description: The human-readable numeric id of the document to retrieve.

get.summary: Returns a preview representation of the document with the specified id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the document whose preview is requested.

get.summary: Returns the most recently added documents visible to the current user.

put.summary: Returns all tags defined in the system.

delete.summary: Permanently deletes the specified container or document and all its contents.

parameters.name: containerOrContaineeId
parameters.description: The id of the container or document to delete.

requestBody.description: The stated reason for the deletion, recorded in the audit log.

delete.summary: Marks the specified container or document as soft-deleted without removing it from storage.

parameters.name: containerOrContaineeId
parameters.description: The id of the container or document to soft-delete.

requestBody.description: The stated reason for the deletion, recorded in the audit log.

put.summary: Authenticates a user with the given credentials and returns an access token on success.
Registers a new user account. Requires administrator privileges.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The username for the new account.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The plain-text password for the new account.

put.summary: Invalidates the current session's access token, logging the user out.

get.summary: Checks whether the given access token is currently valid.

put.summary: Returns the roles assigned to the currently authenticated user.

get.summary: Returns profile information for the currently authenticated user.

DocumentDTO.description: Represents a data transfer object for a full document, including its content.

DocumentPreviewDTO.description: Represents a data transfer object for a document preview, without the full document content.

providerId.description: The provider id that initiated the flow (e.g. "keycloak-1").

code.description: The authorization code received from the OIDC provider callback.

state.description: The state value from the callback, used to look up the stored code verifier.

OIDCCallbackRequestDTO.description: Sent by the frontend to exchange an OIDC authorization code for an OpenDMS access token.

authorizationUrl.description: The full URL to redirect the user's browser to at the OIDC provider.

state.description:
The OIDC state value. The frontend must store this and verify it matches what comes back
in the callback query parameter before calling ExchangeOIDCCode.

OIDCInitiationDTO.description: Returned when initiating an OIDC login; the frontend redirects the user to OpenDMSBackend.Core.Model.DTOs.OIDCInitiationDTO.AuthorizationUrl.

displayName.description: The human-readable label for the login button.

OIDCProviderDTO.description: Public representation of a configured OIDC provider, returned to the frontend.
